paragraph: Two years ago, Rhys Wynne-Jones walked into St. Mary’s Church in Penzance on a cold January night. He had been homeless for a decade in England. Someone recorded him playing piano there. The video went viral. His whole life has turned around since then. He has now raised fifty thousand dollars for charity.
